claims.text: In the simulation the council says the bridge will reopen in a week, the contract says three weeks, an independent engineer says five to seven, and it reopens after forty-six days.
claims.quote: the council says one week, the contract on site says three, an independent engineer says five to seven, and it opens after forty-six days

claims.text: Markus Franz used the bridge closure as his example in The Article Is Only the Beginning, and this article plays it out in full.
claims.quote: Markus Franz used the same example in The Article Is Only the Beginning

claims.text: The paper leads with the bridge on five days while readers need its current state on fifty-seven days.
claims.quote: The paper leads with it five times; readers need it on fifty-seven days.

value.unit: days readers needed the story against days the paper led with it

claims.text: Something actually changed on thirteen of those days, and those are the days the tracker earns its keep.
claims.quote: The thirteen days on which something actually changed are the days the tracker earns its keep

claims.text: An article is written once, but a claim kept current until the bridge opens is a service.
claims.quote: An article is written once. A maintained claim, kept current until the bridge opens, is a service.

claims.text: In the story graph each correction supersedes the last rather than replacing it, so the graph can say what was believed on any day and why.
claims.quote: each correction supersedes the last rather than replacing it, so the graph can still say what was believed on any day and why

claims.text: Each reader's own graph is held on their device and not sent anywhere; it meets the story graph at shared anchors such as the bridge, the footbridge and a bus stop.
claims.quote: it is held on the reader's device and not sent anywhere

claims.text: Hannah paid £2.28 over seven weeks and reckons it was worth about £180 of pay not lost and seventeen hours not spent on buses.
claims.quote: She paid £2.28 over seven weeks.

claims.text: Dev paid £5.76, kept about £640 of stock out of the bin and received £1,200 of relief.
claims.quote: He kept about £640 of stock out of the bin and received £1,200 of relief.

claims.text: Marco paid 54p in alerts and skill runs and saved about nine hours of driving.
claims.quote: He paid 54p, in alerts and skill runs. He saved about nine hours of driving.

claims.text: Hannah received seven WhatsApp messages from the tracker over seven weeks, each about her route and each with its source.
claims.quote: seven messages over seven weeks, each one about her route, each with its source

claims.text: Over 2,392 questions a routing agent that searches spends about $377 in tokens and is wrong for the first week, while asking the newsroom costs about $54 and is right from the 15th.
claims.quote: over 2,392 questions, searching costs about $377 in tokens and is wrong for the first week; asking costs about $54 including the pennies

value.unit: USD, asking against searching, over 2,392 questions

claims.text: The token prices in the agent comparison are illustrative and the vault says so; the shape of the comparison is the point.
claims.quote: The token prices are illustrative and the vault says so; the shape of the comparison is the point.

claims.text: One closure earns £2,707 in the simulation, most of it small amounts from the town.
claims.quote: In the simulation, one closure earns £2,707.

claims.text: Sixty per cent goes to the Courier, which pays the reporter's base salary, twenty per cent to the reporter as commission, ten per cent to infrastructure and ten per cent to evidence contributors.
claims.quote: sixty per cent goes to the Courier, which pays her base salary out of it, and twenty per cent comes to her as a commission on every use

claims.text: Priya, the resident whose photographs were evidence, receives £203 from the evidence contributors' share.
claims.quote: Priya, the resident who photographed the site notice, the footbridge sign and the first traffic, receives £203.

value.unit: GBP to the resident whose photographs were evidence

claims.text: Interviewees are not paid; the people paid are those whose evidence the graph names, because a page that cannot name its source cannot pay it.
claims.quote: a page that cannot name its source cannot pay it.

claims.text: Every figure is an assumption written in the vault where anybody can change it and run the simulation again.
claims.quote: Every figure here is an assumption, and the vault writes them down where anybody can change them and run it again.

claims.text: The fixed cost is 31 hours of the reporter's time and 4.5 of the editor's, £1,350 in all with a legal read, set-up and the platform.
claims.quote: 31 hours of the reporter's time and 4.5 of the editor's, both paid by the Courier, £1,350 with a legal read, set-up and the platform.

claims.text: The story breaks even on 5 November, day twenty-five, and below about 1,000 followers it would not have paid for its reporting.
claims.quote: The story breaks even on 5 November, day twenty-five

claims.text: Over two years the bridge earns £4,378 and £1,871 of profit, and after the reopening 96% of its revenue comes from institutions and agents.
claims.quote: Over two years the bridge earns £4,378 and £1,871 of profit.

claims.text: Twelve stories together earn £26,523 and £14,731 of profit over two years, with 41% of second-year revenue from stories more than three months old.
claims.quote: the twelve together earn £26,523 and £14,731 of profit

value.unit: GBP from twelve stories over two years

claims.text: The editor's expectations and what the town paid for agree on five of twelve stories; the town cared more about the bridge than the newsroom did.
claims.quote: They agree on five of twelve.

value.unit: stories where editor and town agreed

claims.text: Across eight dated stories the outcome lands inside the Courier's range seven times, and the official estimates are out by 34 days on average.
claims.quote: the official estimates are out by 34 days on average

value.unit: days official estimates were out on average

claims.text: With the tracker the council paid 44 of the 52 eligible businesses instead of 18, for £152 of targeting bought from the Courier.
claims.quote: paid 44 of the 52 eligible businesses instead of 18 and none it was not meant for

claims.text: The Ask the graph view answers a question from the claims live that day in 583 tokens against 45,000 for searching six pages, and no model is called.
claims.quote: 583 tokens against 45,000 for searching six pages, about a tenth of the cost and right

claims.text: The API view lists seventeen GET endpoints, each answered by a file already in the vault; readers' graphs have no endpoint because they live on readers' devices.
claims.quote: Readers' graphs have no endpoint: they live on readers' devices.

claims.text: Version 0.3 gave the vault four themes, the same Night, Day, Paper and Ember as secrets.sgit.ai, with every colour a token in one file.
claims.quote: the same Night, Day, Paper and Ember as secrets.sgit.ai

claims.text: An architect agent reviewed the vault's code against the vault-app rules on sgit.ai, coding.sgit.ai and nfrs.sgit.ai, and a developer agent applied the review.
claims.quote: the vault-app rules on sgit.ai, coding.sgit.ai and nfrs.sgit.ai, and a developer agent applied it

claims.text: A gate of 44 checks, from the bundle contract to theme completeness and contrast, fails the build if anything regresses.
claims.quote: a gate of 44 checks, from the bundle contract and byte-for-byte downloads to theme completeness and contrast, fails the build if any of it regresses

claims.text: In version 0.3.1 the reporter's row was corrected to show pay, base salary plus commission, rather than a profit.
claims.quote: In version 0.3.1 her row was corrected to show pay, base salary plus commission, rather than a profit

claims.text: The simulation is not a forecast; it is a way to see the argument whole.
claims.quote: It is not a forecast. It is a way to see the argument whole

claims.text: The opening anecdote about a closed bridge is the author's own experience and not part of the simulation.
claims.quote: The opening anecdote is the author's own experience, not part of the simulation.

claims.text: The article was drafted from a voice note by agent@riskmandate.ai, running Claude Opus 5.5, in the sgit.ai site session on 7 October 2026.
claims.quote: by agent@riskmandate.ai (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) in the sgit.ai site session, on 7 October 2026
